description: Japanese agro-environmental researchers produced the Historical Gridded Meteorological Dataset in Japan for agricultural climate analysis. The Data in Brief article describes approximately one-kilometre daily grids beginning in 1978, based on national weather-station observations and spatial interpolation. The Science Data Bank DOI metadata names temperature, precipitation, radiation, humidity, wind, evapotranspiration and paddy-water temperature among its variables; some products have hourly or yearly time steps. It lists 6,674 files and roughly 283 GB, with binary daily grids keyed by third-order Japanese mesh code and Tokyo Datum coordinates. The named landing page opened, and DataCite states a CC BY-NC 4.0 licence. Repository documentation says possible method and instrument changes were corrected to improve temporal homogeneity, but the degree of residual bias was not checked. Gridded values are interpolations, not direct observations at every cell. A reviewer-assessed use is supplying weather forcing for crop, irrigation and climate-exposure simulations. data-era5-reanalysis is a related gridded atmospheric product, but no spatial or temporal comparison was performed. The licence restricts commercial reuse; individual binary files and any access-account requirement were not tested. No dataset payload or PDF was downloaded.
